VI.description: eDyno NVH accelerometer SIMULATOR - analog output only (PXIe-4468 AO0).\0A\0AContinuously generates\2C with NI-DAQmx and regeneration disabled\2C a voltage that emulates a PCB 356A15 ICP accelerometer (one axis\2C Sensitivity mV/g\2C default 100) on an e-bike drive unit on the eDyno. Acquisition and analysis are deliberately NOT here\3A run them in a separate VI on any AI channel wired to AO0 (with IEPE excitation OFF on that channel - never drive an AO into an IEPE-powered input).\0A\0ASpeed\3A constant\2C or a linear run-up when Speed Profile / Run-up Enabled is ON; every order tracks speed. Switch faults on live in Fault Injection\3A\0A1) Imbalance (1x order\2C grows with rpm^2) / Misalignment (2x order)\0A2) Bearing outer-race defect (impacts at BPFO ringing the housing resonance\3A crest factor and kurtosis rise\2C BPFO-spaced lines around the resonance)\0A3) Motor torque ripple (6 x pole pairs order) and inverter PWM carrier with +/-2fe sidebands.\0A\0AFault Frequencies shows where each fault should appear at the current speed (the answer key for the analysis VI).\0A\0ATiming\3A the AO buffer holds 3 blocks and DAQmx Write blocks when it is full\2C so the loop is paced by the hardware clock and a front-panel change reaches the output within about 3 x (Samples per Block / Sample Rate).
